observation: The first dogfood loop selected no active guidance, so the next loop needs a scoped guidance item to test whether selection becomes usable outcome evidence without being treated as automatic usefulness.
hypothesis: A scoped dogfood guidance item can force one selected-guidance session while preserving explicit outcome judgment and avoiding premature promotion.
validated_conclusion: The second dogfood loop should use a scoped guidance item and then log whether it was helpful, irrelevant, harmful, or not used based on actual task impact.

validation_case.given: a dogfood task intentionally selects scoped guidance
validation_case.then: the outcome is logged explicitly and no promotion is created from a single selection
